summary: BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that the French Ministry of Economics and Finance granted clearance under foreign direct investment screening procedures for its pending merger with Amicus Therapeutics, Inc. The merger, announced December 19, 2025, involves Amicus surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of BioMarin. The French FDI clearance satisfies the final pre-closing condition. Closing is expected on April 27, 2026. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisor names are reiterated in this filing. Watch for the imminent closing and any post-merger integration updates.
